MERGE INTO OFT_RECIPE target USING ( SELECT #{externalRecipeId} AS EXTERNAL_RECIPE_ID, #{recipeName} AS RECIPE_NAME, #{description} AS DESCRIPTION, #{cookTime} AS COOK_TIME, #{difficulty} AS DIFFICULTY, #{calories} AS CALORIES, #{imageUrl} AS IMAGE_URL, #{sourceName} AS SOURCE_NAME FROM DUAL ) source ON (target.EXTERNAL_RECIPE_ID = source.EXTERNAL_RECIPE_ID) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET target.RECIPE_NAME = source.RECIPE_NAME, target.DESCRIPTION = source.DESCRIPTION, target.COOK_TIME = source.COOK_TIME, target.DIFFICULTY = source.DIFFICULTY, target.CALORIES = source.CALORIES, target.IMAGE_URL = source.IMAGE_URL, target.SOURCE_NAME = source.SOURCE_NAME WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( EXTERNAL_RECIPE_ID, RECIPE_NAME, DESCRIPTION, COOK_TIME, DIFFICULTY, CALORIES, IMAGE_URL, SOURCE_NAME ) VALUES ( source.EXTERNAL_RECIPE_ID, source.RECIPE_NAME, source.DESCRIPTION, source.COOK_TIME, source.DIFFICULTY, source.CALORIES, source.IMAGE_URL, source.SOURCE_NAME )
SELECT RECIPE_NO FROM OFT_RECIPE WHERE EXTERNAL_RECIPE_ID = #{externalRecipeId}
mapper.select:
SELECT * FROM ( SELECT r.RECIPE_NO AS recipeNo, r.EXTERNAL_RECIPE_ID AS externalRecipeId, r.RECIPE_NAME AS recipeName, DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(r.DESCRIPTION, 1000, 1) AS description, r.COOK_TIME AS cookTime, r.DIFFICULTY AS difficulty, r.CALORIES AS calories, r.IMAGE_URL AS imageUrl, r.SOURCE_NAME AS sourceName, r.CREATED_AT AS createdAt FROM OFT_RECIPE r WHERE 1 = 1
AND ( UPPER(r.RECIPE_NAME) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%' OR UPPER(DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(r.DESCRIPTION, 4000, 1)) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%' )
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM OFT_RECIPE_INGREDIENT ri WHERE ri.RECIPE_NO = r.RECIPE_NO AND UPPER(ri.INGREDIENT_NAME) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{ingredientKeyword}) || '%' )
ORDER BY
NVL(TO_NUMBER(REGEXP_SUBSTR(r.COOK_TIME, '[0-9]+')), 99999) ASC, r.CREATED_AT DESC, r.RECIPE_NO DESC
CASE r.DIFFICULTY WHEN '쉬움' THEN 1 WHEN '보통' THEN 2 WHEN '어려움' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END ASC, NVL(TO_NUMBER(REGEXP_SUBSTR(r.COOK_TIME, '[0-9]+')), 99999) ASC, r.CREATED_AT DESC, r.RECIPE_NO DESC
r.CREATED_AT DESC, r.RECIPE_NO DESC
) WHERE ROWNUM <= #{limit}

SELECT r.RECIPE_NO AS recipeNo, r.EXTERNAL_RECIPE_ID AS externalRecipeId, r.RECIPE_NAME AS recipeName, DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(r.DESCRIPTION, 4000, 1) AS description, r.COOK_TIME AS cookTime, r.DIFFICULTY AS difficulty, r.CALORIES AS calories, r.IMAGE_URL AS imageUrl, r.SOURCE_NAME AS sourceName FROM OFT_RECIPE r WHERE r.RECIPE_NO = #{recipeNo}

SELECT ri.INGREDIENT_NO AS ingredientNo, ri.RECIPE_NO AS recipeNo, ri.INGREDIENT_NAME AS ingredientName, ri.AMOUNT AS amount FROM OFT_RECIPE_INGREDIENT ri WHERE ri.RECIPE_NO = #{recipeNo} ORDER BY ri.INGREDIENT_NO ASC

SELECT rs.STEP_NO AS stepNo, rs.RECIPE_NO AS recipeNo, rs.STEP_SEQ AS stepSeq, DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(rs.DESCRIPTION, 4000, 1) AS description FROM OFT_RECIPE_STEP rs WHERE rs.RECIPE_NO = #{recipeNo} ORDER BY rs.STEP_SEQ ASC

SELECT rsi.STEP_IMAGE_NO AS stepImageNo, rsi.STEP_NO AS stepNo, rsi.IMAGE_URL AS imageUrl, rsi.SORT_ORDER AS sortOrder FROM OFT_RECIPE_STEP_IMAGE rsi JOIN OFT_RECIPE_STEP rs ON rs.STEP_NO = rsi.STEP_NO WHERE rs.RECIPE_NO = #{recipeNo} ORDER BY rs.STEP_SEQ ASC, rsi.SORT_ORDER ASC
